$comment: Validates _source/verification.json, which is the single source of truth for tables T-334 and T-218 of Chapter 7.

The schema sees the SHAPE. The cross-table join -- every TS id a T-334 row names is one table T-218 defines -- is refused by verification_json_to_md.py, because JSON Schema cannot reach from one array into another.
title: The verification manuscript
description: What the tests verify (table T-334) and where each kind of test lives (table T-218), in print order.

$comment.description: Notes for whoever edits this manuscript. JSON carries no comments, so the role declaration goes here -- one line per note, the same shape settings.json uses. Check 21 reads the first of them. Not rendered.

targets.description: Table T-334: what is verified, where its full count is held, and which rows of table T-218 verify it.

id.description: The row id of table T-334.

population.description: Where the full count is held. No count is written here, so adding a member there changes nothing in this file.

verifiedBy.description: The rows of table T-218 that verify this row. The generator refuses an id table T-218 does not define, and derives table T-218's 確かめるもの column from these links.

places.description: Table T-218: each kind of test, its parent, its level, its folder and its tool.

id.description: The row id of table T-218. A seat number: never renumbered.

alsoVerifies.description: What this place verifies that no row of table T-334 states. Printed after the links the generator derives.

parent.description: The requirement kind a test of this place takes as its parent, or null when it takes none.

level.description: The test level, a note for the reader: the specification holds no test node to write it into (table T-219).

table.description: The table's number and caption, as the printed heading spells them.

prose.description: A cell of the printed document, per language. The manuscript belongs to no language, so the ja/en split is data entry rather than a second copy.
